commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Marco Asensio (PSG) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly wide of the left post.
90+2' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Pape Diallo (Metz), whose header floated just over the bar.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Arthur Atta (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Danley Jean Jacques.
87' Kang-In Lee (PSG) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexandre Oukidja, who smothers the ball.
86' Matthieu Udol (Metz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
83' A superb shot by Georges Mikautadze (Metz) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
83' Metz are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
79' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
78' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yoram Zague (PSG) replacing Nuno Mendes.
77' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot low towards the middle of the net that is easily dealt with by Alexandre Oukidja.
76' Lamine Camara (Metz) tries his luck with a long-range shot, but the ball crashes against the bar. Great effort!
74' Substitution. Kevin Van Den Kerkhof leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
71' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Milan Skriniar (PSG) replaces Lucas Beraldo.
70' Kang-In Lee (PSG) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG.
62' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Goncalo Ramos and he is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
62' Substitution. Ethan Mbappe (PSG) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Senny Mayulu walks off.
61' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Keylor Navas.
61' Marco Asensio (PSG) releases Nuno Mendes, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
57' A long pass, executed by Danilo Pereira (PSG), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
55' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
55' A corner kick by Metz is thwarted by the well prepared Keylor Navas (PSG).
53' Wasted effort! Manuel Ugarte (PSG) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
50' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
48' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Marco Asensio (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Nuno Mendes (PSG) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
43' The resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG) comes to nothing.
43' The goalkeeper dives to deny Kang-In Lee (PSG), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post. PSG force a corner. They send men into the box.
41' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Keylor Navas comes off his line to intercept.
40' The shots on goal statistics – 1:4.
38' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Alexandre Oukidja.
36' Marco Asensio (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
34' Marco Asensio (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
32' What a big chance! Marco Asensio (PSG) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
32' Excellent touch by Nordi Mukiele (PSG)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
29' PSG are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
28' Kang-In Lee (PSG) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alexandre Oukidja is well positioned and punches the ball away.
26' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
23' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) finds Manuel Ugarte with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
22' Pape Diallo (Metz) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
16' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.

14' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Gael Angoula signals that the goal stands! The PSG players celebrate. Goal! Marco Asensio plays a simple square pass into the feet of Kang-In Lee (PSG) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
13' PSG score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
12' Kang-In Lee (PSG) has a goal ruled out for offside!
11' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
11' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
10' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

7' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Carlos Soler (PSG) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Alexandre Oukidja just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
7' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Nuno Mendes (PSG) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
4' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula will referee today's match.
